messages:
evan: Post-GA checklist time. We need a tight plan for next-week post-launch iteration 1: balance two urgent bugs vs two small enhancements. My ask: make this a single micro-wave with strict risk gates, unless runtime/kernel touches require isolation.
clare: Can we define the risk gates now? Last time we accidentally drifted scope.
nate: Proposal: MSC (minimum shippable change) = single customer-visible bug fix OR one UX tweak. If more than one backend-runtime file changes -> split. No DB migrations, no schema flips. Feature flags OK.
anya: Additions: require a smoke script + golden traces before promote, and a 6h quiet window after canary for monitoring. If crash-related fix -> canary-only initially.
evans: Agreed. Let's map owners: nate -> crash fixer (if that is one of the bugs), clare -> embed throttling tweak (enhancement), anya -> QA + telemetry.
qa-bot: Test plan queued: long_prompt_repro (10 seeds), embedding_throttle_load (synthetic 2000 req/min), onboarding_copy_flow. Will post artifacts to CI.
nate: Practical timeline: Day0 open PRs and mark them patch/micro/5182468012-*. Day1 morning: crash canary (if included) at 02:30 PT. Watch 6h. If green -> Day1 evening: promote with enhancement bundle. If crash is absent or trivial, do single promote.
clare: Rollback policy: automatic rollback triggers if error rate >1% above baseline OR support mentions spike >25 in 6h OR p99 latency increase >300ms. Manual rollback if data drift flagged.
anya: Telemetry snapshots: capture BEFORE and AFTER token distribution, p99 CPU, KV-cache hit ratio. I'll create temporary dashboard tiles titled micro/5182468012-before and micro/5182468012-after.
evans: Comms decision: only send customer-facing note if >75 users affected or billing deltas >0.5% within 12h. Otherwise internal incident note.
ate: CI snippet I'll add to the PR: ```bash
# smoke job for long prompts
./ci/run_smoke.sh --scenario long_prompt --seeds 10 --retries 2
```
qa-bot: Smoke will run on canary and full test suite on promote. Also adding a short repro harness to the bug ticket.
clare: On the enhancements: onboarding copy + smaller default batch size for embeddings. Both are reversible via FF, so lower risk. We'll bundle them only if no runtime changes in crash PR.
evans: Final plan: 1) Create tickets and PRs today. 2) Lock freeze 01:00 PT next day. 3) If crash touches runtime -> canary/crash first, then promote enhancements separately 24h later. 4) If no runtime change, single promote at 03:00 PT with telemetry watch for 12h. Owners: nate, clare, anya. Signoffs: evan + clare required to promote.
release-bot: Release plan created: canary/5182468012-crash -> promote/5182468012-1 -> promote/5182468012-2 (conditional). Manual approvals set for evan + clare.
anya: Quick pre-freeze huddle 00:45 PT. I'll prepare the dashboard and the templated customer note.
evans: Thanks, team. Keep PRs small, link to the patch/micro tags, and avoid scope creep. :folded_hands:
